prompt: We just shipped v2.4.0 with three new features and two bug fixes. Add the new release entry.

assertions.text: Uses Keep a Changelog format with ## [2.4.0] heading and date
Groups bug fixes under ### Fixed section
All 5 changes are present (OAuth2, CSV export, dark mode, WebSocket leak, timezone fix)
Descriptions are clear and user-focused, not vague single words
Includes comparison link reference at bottom (e.g., [2.4.0]: .../compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0)
